Synthetic cohort only — outputs are **not** paper results.

Healthy-window edgeR (`~ apoe_4 + dataset`, `coef = 2`) and Poisson `FindMarkers`
(latents `dataset.num`, `projid.num`, `sex_num`), plus a Fig 5-style volcano.

CLI equivalent: `Rscript notebooks/02_deg_and_fig5_heatmap.R` (from `DeepDynamics/analyses/`).

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r run}
source("notebooks/02_deg_and_fig5_heatmap.R")
```

## Volcano (edgeR)

```{r volcano, fig.width=5, fig.height=4.5}
print(p)
```
